content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have an application using [product_name] [article_no] ([product_name] [product_name]) for generator switchboards (similar to [product_name] Micro Automation Set 29) and I am looking to add remote service functionality. By teleservice, I mean a fully transparent connection allowing program downloads/uploads, monitoring and variable changes, unlike basic GSM modems. Has anyone tested a modem setup (both PSTN & GSM), with INSYS or other brands? Assistance finding a working solution would be greatly appreciated since this feature is crucial for deciding whether to choose [product_name] or another product. Other competing products, such as Zelio from Telemecanique, offer this built-in. Kind regards, [user_name]

Hello, I'm not specialized in modem configuration. Generally, [product_name] devices require an 11-bit protocol, while GSM uses a 10-bit protocol. However, most modems allow the RS232 connection to be set to 11 bits, even if GSM communication itself uses 10 bits. For more detailed information, a modem expert familiar with protocol changes would be needed to assist you. Please share any results, as I have received similar requests but haven't had time to find a solution. Regards, [user_name]
Thank you, [user_name]. Can you provide information about PSTN modems?

Hello, I tested with the INSYS Pocket 56K modem as described in the [company_name] manual, and it worked very well. Upload, download, and online testing were successful. I followed the setup shown in training slide 134 at [url]. For this, you need two serial [product_name] cables and a specific [product_name] modem cable ([article_no]), along with the modems. I do not have experience with other analog modems. Hope this helps.

Thank you, [user_name]. Is the INSYS Pocket 56 modem distributed through [company_name], or should I purchase directly from INSYS? That covers PSTN; any ideas regarding GSM modems? Any suggestions are appreciated. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for dependable remote service features such as remote programming, monitoring, and changing variables for generator switchboards using [product_name] hardware, specifically with modem support for PSTN and GSM connections using [product_name] software. There is trust in [company_name] documentation for PSTN modem compatibility, but users are unsure about suitable GSM solutions. Competing products offer these features by default, which may impact purchasing choices. Ensuring protocol compatibility between devices and modems adds a technical challenge for users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate reliable and straightforward remote access, including program upload/download and monitoring through both PSTN and GSM modems via [product_name] software on the [product_name] platform, paralleling solutions available with competing products.
